posts.meta_description:
eightsleep on September 29, 2026: "Before Pod 6 was public, @charles_leclerc visited our San Francisco office to see what we were working on, test it for himself, and give us his honest feedback.

Months later, we got to show him the finished Pod 6. Six generations of learning, packed into our smallest Pod yet. Proud to have Charles along for the journey. More to come.".
